scoring_rule: mean of gene-wise standardized expression values for the listed genes; equal weights; no outcome-based refitting
normalization: gene-wise standardization parameters must be estimated in a declared development dataset and then reused unchanged; if unavailable, report only within-cohort descriptive z-scores and do not call them external validation
missing_gene_rule: score only if at least 80 percent of the requested genes are measured; otherwise missing

melanoma_braf_mapk_escape.development_context: GSE99898 treatment-state expression; descriptive development only

breast_pi3k_pathway_activity.development_context: pathway-defined exploratory signature; no patient-level NEO-ORB development matrix available
breast_pi3k_pathway_activity.external_context: NEO-ORB and brca_mskcc_2019 only when expression is available
breast_pi3k_pathway_activity.endpoint: treatment response or progression, kept separate by study design
breast_pi3k_pathway_activity.direction: mean positive-pathway genes minus standardized PTEN expression

pancreas_stromal_immune_exclusion.development_context: public PRINCE RNA-seq; descriptive development only
pancreas_stromal_immune_exclusion.external_context: Wainberg 2020 when expression data are available

prohibitions: Do not call these scores clinically validated.
Do not refit genes, weights, thresholds, or directions on an external cohort.
Do not pool PRE/EDT/PROG, response, PFS, and OS as one endpoint.
Do not infer treatment benefit from these descriptive scores.
